Once a prosperous silver mining camp, Aspen evolved into a year-round mountain retreat for the rich and famous. It was a place where the powerful could forget the hustle and bustle of their hectic lives.

An affair between two officers in the Santa Monica Police Department turns violent and leads to revelations that many members of the force were more interested in sex and money than they were in fighting crime. Narrated by Paul Winfield.
When three visitors to Signal Mountain are murdered in the woods, suspicion falls on Frank Casteel, who liked to threaten trespassers with his shotgun.
High-powered record promoter Charlie Minor, who garnered fame and fortune boosting the careers of artists like Sting and Janet Jackson, lived the high life in Malibu.
Family stories in the Deep South are known for their Faulknerian turns. The story of the Alabama Twins is no different.
When Hawaii police officer Kenneth Mathison is suspected of killing his wife, authorities let him off with only a slap on the wrist.
A police arson investigator is suspected of strangling his wife to death and then setting her body on fire to cover up the crime. Paul Winfield narrates.
A college student living in a fantasy world and obsessed with the game Dungeons and Dragons is charged with the brutal murder of his stepfather in North Carolina.
